description: This file defines the LeaveType class which extends the Document class from frappe. It contains validation logic for leave type objects, including checks for leave without pay (LWP), partial pay (PPL), and related leave allocations.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: A class representing leave type documents with validation logic for leave configurations.

methods.name: validate(self)
methods.description: Performs validation checks to ensure leave type configurations are consistent, including linking leave allocations, leave without pay, partial pay, and fraction of daily salary constraints.
